scope: Context inspection covers all valid sources; native inspection is targeted, not a full per-source native quality audit. The six visual withholds comprise four train hashes and two already-reserved validation hashes. Earlier two malformed ICC failures remain in their separate preserved ledger. Retained sources still require completed protected/duplicate/title/content-series review. No originals, caches or active training/evaluation data changed. No improved-model quality claim.
